Internationale Studierende, d.h. Staatsangehörige aus nicht EU- oder EWR-Ländern, zahlen in Baden-Württemberg eine Studiengebühr von 1.500 € je Semester.
The following is valid for applicants from: non-EU countries For the summer semester: until 15 November
The following is valid for applicants from: non-EU countries For the winter semester: until 15 May
Bewerbungsfrist Wintersemester: 15.05 für ausländische Bewerberinnen und Bewerber; 15.07 für deutsche und Deutschen gleichgestellte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber

notes: Tuition: the EUR 1,500 per semester is a general Baden-Württemberg fee for international (non-EU/EEA) students at Reutlingen University; no programme-specific non-EU fee is stated for this Bachelor. Application channel: the pages only describe the university's own online application portal and never mention uni-assist, so "de-university-direct" was chosen. Intake deadline "15 May" for non-EU winter applicants appears both on the DAAD page and (15.05 für ausländische Bewerber) on the university's programme list; no application-open date is given. The DAAD page also states German language and culture preparatory courses for first-semester international students, but no German language level is required for admission (quote: "German language skills No minimum language level required").
